origin: Toyota Gazoo Racing BR (TGR BR) emerged from the passionate weekend racing scene of São Paulo in the early 2010s. A group of friends, led by the ambitious Ricardo Silva, initially campaigned a heavily modified Toyota Corolla in local touring car events. Their initial forays were characterized by shoestring budgets, improvised repairs, and a relentless determination to improve. The team quickly became a local favorite, known for their underdog spirit and the distinctive yellow and green livery of their Corolla.
philosophy: TGR BR's philosophy centers around continuous learning and improvement. They believe in maximizing the performance of their existing equipment through meticulous preparation and driver development. Their team culture is built on camaraderie, open communication, and a shared passion for motorsport. They approach car development with a pragmatic, data-driven mindset, focusing on incremental gains rather than radical changes.
achievements: 2017 - Campeonato Paulista de Turismo - Division 2 Champion
2019 - Stock Series Light - Top 5 in Team Championship
Multiple class wins in regional endurance races (e.g., 500 Milhas de Kart Granja Viana)

teamPrincipal.name: Ricardo Silva
teamPrincipal.background: Ricardo Silva is a lifelong motorsport enthusiast and the driving force behind TGR BR. His hands-on approach and unwavering commitment to the team have been instrumental in their success, fostering a family-like atmosphere within the organization.

keyFigures.name: Isabela Costa
keyFigures.description: Isabela Costa is a highly skilled mechanic with a knack for diagnosing and resolving complex mechanical issues. She is known for her resourcefulness and ability to keep the cars running despite limited resources.

headquarters: TGR BR operates out of a modest workshop on the outskirts of São Paulo. Their facilities are basic but functional, providing the necessary space for car preparation and maintenance. The workshop also serves as a gathering place for the team's dedicated volunteers and supporters.
fanBase: TGR BR enjoys a loyal following among local motorsport enthusiasts who appreciate their grassroots origins and never-say-die attitude. Their yellow and green Corolla is a familiar sight at race tracks across the state, and their pit area is always buzzing with enthusiastic supporters.
